# case-0001

A compact decoder-only language model.
The training process followed a standard pretraining and fine-tuning recipe.
A testing process with a documented evaluation procedure was applied.
Training compute was approximately 2048 accelerator-days.
Energy consumption and estimated carbon emissions were recorded during training.
Training data consisted of a documented mixture of public text corpora.
Intended use is general-purpose English text generation.
Technical means for integration into AI systems are provided to downstream providers.
Acceptable use and out-of-scope uses are described for operators.
Input and output modality is text, encoded as UTF-8.
The distribution channel is the public model hub.
A copyright policy consistent with the provider duty is published.
A public training content summary accompanies this release.
